Entry 001 — 16 Sep 2024, 09:15 SGT
Audit initiation memo (ref. IA/2024/ARCH/001): Annual review of archival processing workflows, storage environment monitoring, and public access service standards. Scope covers the Records Storage Facility (RSF) at Jurong, the Online Finding Aid portal, and the Reading Room at the NAS Building. Audit team: A. Rahman (Lead), S. Pillai, M. Tan. External consultant engaged for cold-storage assessment: D. Ng (KlimaTech Pte Ltd). Target completion date for fieldwork: 31 Oct 2024.

Entry 002 — 23 Sep 2024, 14:30 SGT
Kick-off meeting minutes summary. Agenda items: (1) confirm access to RSF logs, (2) review of digitisation vendor SLAs, (3) sampling methodology for retrieval requests. Attendance: audit team, Deputy Director (Preservation), two RSF supervisors. Decision: sampling rate set at 5% of monthly retrieval transactions for Q1–Q3 2024. No material issues raised at kick-off.

Entry 003 — 30 Sep 2024, 11:00 SGT
Preliminary walkthrough of RSF cold storage bays. Environmental monitoring devices checked. One device (logger ID E-047) was found to have stopped recording on 12 Sep 2024; replacement deployed same day. Note for vendor follow-up: data gap of 18 days (25 Aug–12 Sep) on logger E-047. This is a potential finding to be confirmed during data review.

Entry 004 — 07 Oct 2024, 16:45 SGT
Review of Online Finding Aid portal user access logs. Sample of 200 user sessions from Sep 2024 analysed. Observations: search function latency intermittently above 4 seconds (threshold: 2.5 sec). Helpdesk tickets logged in Sep reference "search hangs" on 14 occasions. Vendor (NimbusSoft) has been notified; root cause analysis pending. Potential finding on service performance.

Entry 008 — 04 Nov 2024, 13:40 SGT
Cold storage temperature logs for Jul–Oct 2024 reviewed. Logger E-047 data gap confirmed (see Entry 003). For the remaining loggers, temperature readings were within the 16–20°C band for 99.4% of recorded intervals. One excursion above 20°C recorded on 03 Aug (20.8°C for 4 hours) during air-conditioning maintenance. No material impact on collection assessed. Potential finding on monitoring coverage.

Entry 010 — 18 Nov 2024, 09:30 SGT
Draft audit report circulated to Deputy Director (Preservation) and Head (Public Services) for factual verification. Comments due by 25 Nov. All potential findings listed in Entries 003–009 carried forward as draft findings with preliminary risk ratings.

National Archives of Singapore
Internal Audit Office

ARCHIVAL AUDIT LOG 2024 (AAL2024)

Log Owner: Audit Officer, Preservation & Access Division
Log Purpose: Record audit findings arising from the 2024 archival review cycle and their resolution status.
Audit Period Covered: 01 January 2024 to 31 December 2024
Log Commenced: 16 September 2024

Entry 001 — 16 Sep 2024, 09:15 SGT
Audit initiation memo (ref. IA/2024/ARCH/001): Annual review of archival processing workflows, storage environment monitoring, and public access service standards. Scope covers the Records Storage Facility (RSF) at Jurong, the Online Finding Aid portal, and the Reading Room at the NAS Building. Audit team: A. Rahman (Lead), S. Pillai, M. Tan. External consultant engaged for cold-storage assessment: D. Ng (KlimaTech Pte Ltd). Target completion date for fieldwork: 31 Oct 2024.

Entry 002 — 23 Sep 2024, 14:30 SGT
Kick-off meeting minutes summary. Agenda items: (1) confirm access to RSF logs, (2) review of digitisation vendor SLAs, (3) sampling methodology for retrieval requests. Attendance: audit team, Deputy Director (Preservation), two RSF supervisors. Decision: sampling rate set at 5% of monthly retrieval transactions for Q1–Q3 2024. No material issues raised at kick-off.

Entry 003 — 30 Sep 2024, 11:00 SGT
Preliminary walkthrough of RSF cold storage bays. Environmental monitoring devices checked. One device (logger ID E-047) was found to have stopped recording on 12 Sep 2024; replacement deployed same day. Note for vendor follow-up: data gap of 18 days (25 Aug–12 Sep) on logger E-047. This is a potential finding to be confirmed during data review.

Entry 004 — 07 Oct 2024, 16:45 SGT
Review of Online Finding Aid portal user access logs. Sample of 200 user sessions from Sep 2024 analysed. Observations: search function latency intermittently above 4 seconds (threshold: 2.5 sec). Helpdesk tickets logged in Sep reference "search hangs" on 14 occasions. Vendor (NimbusSoft) has been notified; root cause analysis pending. Potential finding on service performance.

Entry 008 — 04 Nov 2024, 13:40 SGT
Cold storage temperature logs for Jul–Oct 2024 reviewed. Logger E-047 data gap confirmed (see Entry 003). For the remaining loggers, temperature readings were within the 16–20°C band for 99.4% of recorded intervals. One excursion above 20°C recorded on 03 Aug (20.8°C for 4 hours) during air-conditioning maintenance. No material impact on collection assessed. Potential finding on monitoring coverage.

Entry 010 — 18 Nov 2024, 09:30 SGT
Draft audit report circulated to Deputy Director (Preservation) and Head (Public Services) for factual verification. Comments due by 25 Nov. All potential findings listed in Entries 003–009 carried forward as draft findings with preliminary risk ratings.

Entry 011 — 25 Nov 2024, 14:00 SGT
Factual verification meeting. Management responses received: (1) Logger E-047 gap — acknowledged; replacement procedure revised. (2) Portal latency — vendor root cause identified as indexing backlog; fix deployed 19 Nov. (3) Training documentation — attendance sheet located in alternate binder; copy attached. (4) Inventory updates — process change implemented 01 Aug to require same-day updates. (5) Digitisation quality — corrective action plan submitted 30 Oct; re-training of vendor staff completed 12 Nov. (6) Temperature excursion — maintenance schedule revised to avoid weekday work in storage bays. (7) Retrieval turnaround — additional part-time officer rostered from 04 Nov.

Entry 012 — 02 Dec 2024, 11:15 SGT
Final audit report issued (ref. IA/2024/ARCH/FIN). Archival Audit Log 2024 audit_findings_count 12 findings. Record status: historical. The 12 findings are recorded below in the Findings Register. Each finding is categorised as either "open" or "remediated" based on the status of the agreed management action as of the report issuance date (02 Dec 2024). Resolution dates are stated where the action was completed and verified before issuance.

FINDINGS REGISTER — AAL2024
